research_gate.reason: Export freeze is already covered by the research-verified publication/export standards profile, Document ownership boundary, editorial lifecycle amendment and provenance projection. This objective adds a bounded parent runtime over those closed requirements rather than a new unresearched capability.

reuse: EXPORT_RELEASE minimum fields: release_id, frozen_version_id, format, digest, approval_state, publication_authority_state
FINALIZATION, EXPORT_FROZEN and PUBLISHED_OR_DELIVERED top-level states
canonical_parent_state.finding: The executable validator accepts additive fields on EXPORT_RELEASE objects, so richer freeze evidence can be bound without replacing the qualified canonical-state model.

reuse: EXPORT_FROZEN->PUBLISHED_OR_DELIVERED separately requires AUTHOR_APPROVED_EXPORT_PRESENT and PUBLICATION_AUTHORIZATION
lifecycle_transition.finding: Export Freeze must not mutate project lifecycle status. The existing qualified Lifecycle engine remains the sole status-transition authority.

reuse: EXPORT_RELEASE is already a recognized parent authority kind
authorized parent successor ingestion binds exact pre/post parent identities and receipts
lifecycle status change is explicitly refused outside the qualified Lifecycle engine
provider technical states stop at POST_LAYOUT_PROOF_COMPLETE
providers cannot return EXPORT_FROZEN or PUBLICATION_AUTHORIZED
artifact currentness, target-medium profile, validation, source-to-render integrity, accessibility, proof, correction ledger and provenance are already defined provider evidence

author_decision_queue.reuse: Author decisions remain separate and are required only where policy/content/publication authority requires them; export freeze itself does not synthesize or imply publication authorization.

selected_authority_sequence: 1. While project status remains FINALIZATION, parent Export Freeze runtime validates an exact canonical manuscript and exact rendered artifact against current target-medium, proof, rights/privacy and provenance evidence.

2. Export Freeze runtime appends one immutable EXPORT_RELEASE with approval_state=FROZEN, publication_authority_state=NOT_AUTHORIZED and evidence_type=EXPORT_FREEZE_READY; it does not change project status.
3. Version/Rollback records that already-committed parent successor with authority_kind=EXPORT_RELEASE and exact release receipt identity.
4. Existing qualified Lifecycle Transition Engine separately executes FINALIZATION->EXPORT_FROZEN using the registered release as EXPORT_FREEZE_READY evidence.
5. Version/Rollback separately records the Lifecycle successor under authority_kind=LIFECYCLE_TRANSITION.
6. Publication/delivery remains a later author-authorized transition and cannot be inferred from freeze.

release_granularity.reason: The qualified parent EXPORT_RELEASE object has one format and one digest. Avoid changing the base schema or hiding multiple byte identities behind one digest.
release_granularity.multi_format_rule: A logical edition/release may group multiple release IDs by additive release_group_ref, but each format artifact is frozen, invalidated and re-frozen independently by exact digest.

KEEP: existing EXPORT_RELEASE collection and REGISTER_EXPORT_RELEASE operation
generation vs validation vs proof vs freeze vs publication separation
ADD_OR_REFINE: bounded parent Export Freeze runtime and immutable release receipt
exact source manuscript identity and exact artifact currentness fields
target-medium profile identity and technical proof bundle
release_group_ref for optional multi-format grouping without combining artifact digests
explicit handoff to Lifecycle instead of same-operation status mutation
DO_NOT_ADD: provider or Document System export-freeze authority
mutation of a prior frozen release record when bytes/source/profile change
reuse of stale proof, provenance or rights evidence
transfer of prior exact-SHA qualification to Export Freeze runtime

invalidation_model.old_release_behavior: Preserve the old release exactly and append a new invalidation/supersession evidence record or successor release identity; never rewrite the frozen digest.
invalidation_model.requires_unfreeze_transition_when_projec: Use existing EXPORT_FROZEN->FINALIZATION Lifecycle transition with EXPORT_FREEZE_INVALIDATED evidence before a replacement freeze can become current.
new_freeze_required_when: canonical manuscript version or digest changes
required proof/validation becomes failed or stale
required provenance becomes stale, withdrawn or invalid
accepted proof correction regenerates artifact bytes
